text.tspan: GraphNet (fixed MNIST pixel graph) | Operators & tensor flow
MNIST28x28 / N=784 / fixed normalized A / one A@pixels / Linear784->10 / eval / read bottom to top
N=784 pixel nodes; B=batch; scalar node features; same fixed A shared across images
gray side panel: constructor-only graph; dashed A/B routes: buffer and shape dependencies
blue: A@X neighbor sum / purple: whole-image Linear / green: class Softmax
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
